parsed.internal_thinking: Hadar is offering 1 Wood for 1 Wheat. I currently have 2 Wheat and 1 Sheep. My Wheat production is strong (Nodes 43 and 50 cover Hexes 18, 15, and 14, which are Wheat 9, 6, and 9 respectively), even with one 9 blocked by the robber. I have no Wood in hand and need it to expand my road network and build new settlements. Hadar is tied with me at 4 VP, but this trade is mutually beneficial as I need the Wood for my next move. Given our history, showing a bit of cooperation now might also help smooth things over after my betrayal in the last game, while still being a strategically sound move for my own growth.
parsed.note_to_self: Accepted a trade with Hadar (1 Wood for 1 Wheat). I need to focus on getting Bricks next to utilize the Wood for a road/settlement. Node 30 gives me access to Brick on 10.
parsed.say_outloud: הצעה טובה, הדר. עץ באמת יעזור לי עכשיו לצאת מהתקיעות ולבנות משהו. בואי נסגור על זה.
